r51: Regulate: breathe out slowly and relax your shoulders and jaw
r52: Reflect: ask "Is there any truth here I need to hear? What is theirs to carry?"
r53: Respond: choose a calm sentence, such as "I want to talk, but not like this"
r54: If it continues, step away: "I'll come back when we can speak respectfully"

r57: Prepare one sentence ahead of time and practise it
